food-sate-rembiga.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Sate Rembiga from Lombok: a small fan-shaped group of bamboo skewers bearing short irregular tender beef cubes, coated in brick-red chili spice marinade and charred dark at the edges. Served on a simple banana-leaf-lined plate with a few cut white compressed-rice lontong pieces. Beef is the clear focus. No peanut sauce, no minced coconut meat sausage, no chicken satay, no giant meat chunks and no whole chili decoration dominating the food.
